data.title: 新垣绫濑 · 放学后窗边水手服轻抚长发的微叹
data.description: 放学后的千叶私立中学教室，夕阳金光穿过落地窗，绫濑静立在窗边，修长的指尖轻挽耳畔黑发，为某人的秘密行径轻轻叹息却满含关切。
data.location: 黄昏无人私立学校教室窗前
data.action: 单手挽起鬓边青丝，微蹙娥眉望着窗外操场，水手服百褶裙在微风中轻荡
data.lighting: 绚烂的落日余晖洒满教室，拉出纤长的剪影，发丝边缘泛起金光
data.camera: 中景平视，唯美青春日系画风
data.promptProse: Ayase Aragaki stands pensively beside a tall classroom window in the quiet aftermath of the school day. She is dressed in her neat navy-and-white private school sailor uniform with a neatly tied red neckerchief and pleated skirt. As the golden sunset floods the room, casting long dramatic shadows across empty desks, she gently tucks a strand of silky black hair behind her ear, her expression tinged with affectionate worry.
data.animaCaption: Warm sunset light washes over the empty classroom as Ayase tucks her dark hair behind her ear with a soft, affectionate sigh.
